title: Jack's Fried Chicken Large Value Meal $10 (RRP $21.90) Delivered @ Hungry Jacks via Uber Eats (Delivery & Service Fees Apply)
body:
Deal: Jack's Fried Chicken Large Value Meal $10 (RRP $21.90) Delivered @ Hungry Jacks via Uber Eats (Delivery & Service Fees Apply)

[Rakddon] If you don't have Uber One then pick up is also $10
[Craze] Personally was disappointed with onion rings at HJ!
[payton] It's the sheer inconsistency also, sometimes on a nice day, the sleeve or box is overfilled with onion rings, other times its hardly 60% filled.
[umoddbro] It's really luck of the draw, sometimes they turn up pretty good other times it's dry as cardboard.
[brandogs] FYI you wont get a free glass, I ordered this for lunch and its not on the order receipt to remind HJ workers to give a free glass.
[payton] if picking up the order, could just ask for it and show them the UE page showing free glass is included?
[brandogs] Vast majority of people would get this delivered as most of us have free Uber One membership. But yes you are right for those that choose pickup
[payton] My local HJ isn't too far away so I tend to pickup to avoid issues with food getting cold bcs the driver is doing multiple stops and no service fee.
Damn shame that KFC and Maccas don't allow pickups like HJ.
[brandogs] @payton: You're not wrong there, chips were cold as they put them right next to the cold drink in the bag 😂
[payton] @brandogs: 😬
"My disappointment is immeasurable and my day is ruined"
[Craze] @Rakddon: It's dried up but see if you're eligible here and here , or this
[brandogs] I'm still waiting for uber support to get back to me 😕
[unison] @capslock janitor: Got a full refund for missing glass
[umoddbro] Mine delivered and I got the glass, maybe your store forgot to put one in.
[capslock janitor] no glass in my order tonight :\
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/comment/18025783/redir
[TogTogTogTog] That's surprising, normally my HJ's has glass in it, sometimes even a hair.
[Altashi] I got the glass with my order, and there's nothing on the receipt about it.
[pandadude] I agree. Note customer service is dragging their feet on this one.
Uber one Ai won't chase up free items if it not listed 0 item.
Customer services put me in contact with a specialist which will get back to me in 24 hours even thought their chat says 6 to 12 hours.
[darkmoss] it does say on the uber promo that it comes with a free glass
[tc423] $9.49 Delivery Fee + Service Fee w/ Uber One
[thousandsuns] Thanks for the midnight munchie satisfier 😋
[lil_daredevil] Is this targeted? Comes up at full price on my account
[MrZ] It's not fried chicken, it's a fried chicken burger
